m: dhairya n. ( dhīra) intelligence, forethought (opp. to mālvya), VS.; Kāṭh.
dhairya n. ( dhīra) firmness, constancy, calmness, patience, gravity, fortitude, courage, (˚ryaṃ-√ kṛ or ava-lamb or ā-lamb, to compose one's self, gather courage), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: dhairyaṃ [dhīrasya bhāvaḥ karma vā ṣyaña] 1  Firmness, durability, strength, constancy, steadiness, stability, fortitude, courage; dhairyamavaṣṭabhya Pt. 1; vipadi dhairyaṃ Bh. 2. 63; so dhairyavṛtti Śi. 9. 59. 2 Calmness, composure. 3 Gravity, patience. 4 Inflexibility. 5 Boldness, forwardness; Me. 40 (dhāṣṭye Malli.).
